data.description: Safety Review Committee review required prior to titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day on Day 29
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Precluding Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants may remain at 15 mg/day if dose escalation poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Hepatic Dose Modification Criterion (Bilirubin/ALT)
data.description: Liver injury signal requiring temporary interruption of dosing
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 x ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neutrophil Decline Dose Modification Criterion
data.description: Hematologic criterion for dose reduction
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Criterion
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening triggers dose modification evaluation
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale must be documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Criterion
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening triggers dose modification evaluation
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification.

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Conditions and limits for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge after bilirubin elevation at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, requiring approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge.

data.name: Enrollment/Registration Condition
data.description: Definition of enrollment
data.text: 'Enrolled' means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: Women of Childbearing Potential Enrollment Condition
data.description: Negative pregnancy test required before enrollment
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Drug/Alcohol Screen Condition at Day -8
data.description: Negative toxicology and alcohol screens required at Screening and Day -8
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids not tested), or positive alcohol breath test at screening or on Day -8, excludes participation.

data.name: Diet Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to complete controlled meals throughout study
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded.

data.name: Adaptive Design Condition
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Investigator approval required to extend outpatient period
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. Participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing; the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Retention in CRU During Outpatient Period
data.description: Participant may remain inpatient instead of being discharged
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding After Enrollment
data.description: Investigator determination of continued participation after clinically significant finding
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to, changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up Contact Condition
data.description: Required contact attempts before declaring lost to follow-up
data.text: Before a participant is deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the participant's last known mailing address).

data.name: Screening to Run-in/Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled/registered on Day -7 and initiated on a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet; participants are admitted to the CRU on Day -8. Prior zinc must be discontinued at least 21 days before Day 1 and chelator therapy discontinued approximately 4 days prior to initiating ALXN1840.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (Day -7 through Day -1, including baseline intake/output collection Day -4 through Day -1), participants are administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1 through Day 28.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain study integrity. During the Outpatient Period, participants confirm study intervention administration via SMS text messaging.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who were discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) for Treatment Period 2; all procedures will start on Day 23 and participants remain in house until Day 40. If the Outpatient Period was extended (up to 14 additional days), the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Titration from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: After a minimum of 4 weeks at 15 mg/day (Day 1 through Day 28) and SRC review of available safety data through Day 23, the dose is increased to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, unless safety concerns preclude escalation in which case the participant remains on 15 mg/day.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Neutrophil Decline
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline in neutrophils with baseline below reference range: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatotoxicity
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 x ULN, indicative of liver injury, requires temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN and requires Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurologic or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For evidence of neurologic worsening or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening, the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase, or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety/Protocol Reasons
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Remain in Study for Safety Follow-up After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up, with data collected per the Schedule of Activities.

data.name: Post-Treatment Transition to Other Therapy
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (ie, Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access.

data.name: Withdrawal From Study at Participant or Investigator Discretion
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons; the participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities (End of Study Visit on Day 54 +/- 2 days). The end of the study is the date the last participant completes the last visit in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (End of Study/Early Termination Visit, including full physical examination) should be conducted as shown in the SoA. The reason for discontinuation must be recorded in source documents and the CRF.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site; after 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter, a participant who remains unreachable will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Withdrawal of Consent
data.description: A participant may withdraw consent at any time; Alexion may retain and continue to use data collected before withdrawal of consent, and the participant may request destruction of untested samples.

data.name: Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires consideration for discontinuation of study intervention.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor or Investigator
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol, IRB/IEC or local health authority requirements, Alexion procedures, or GCP guidelines; inadequate recruitment; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. Investigators may initiate site closure with reasonable cause and sufficient advance notice.

data.name: Non-compliance with Protocol Requirements
data.description: Participants may be withdrawn at the discretion of the Investigator for behavioral or compliance reasons, including use of disallowed medication or inability to comply with the controlled diet and study procedures.

data.name: SRC Dose Escalation Decision
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the Safety Review Committee reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant to determine whether dose escalation may proceed.

data.name: Day 9 Discharge Decision
data.description: Decision whether to discharge participant from the CRU on Day 9 or retain inpatient for safety or study integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decision whether to extend the Outpatient Period by up to 14 additional days, with provision of additional investigational product; participant resumes Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Safety Laboratory Dose Modification Decision
data.description: Review of chemistry, hematology, and coagulation results on Days -8, -1, 8, 23, and 28 (and weekly repeat testing) to determine dose reduction, interruption, or restriction of dose increases.

data.name: Rechallenge Decision
data.description: Decision by Investigator in consultation with the Alexion Medical Monitor on rechallenge dose and frequency after dose interruption; maximum of 3 rechallenges.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Assessment Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor decision on dose modification based on neurologic or psychiatric worsening, re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Eligibility Confirmation at Enrollment (Day -7) and Check-in (Day -8)
data.description: Confirmation of eligibility, negative pregnancy test, negative drug/alcohol screens, and willingness to comply with controlled diet before registration and initiation of the controlled diet.

data.name: End of Treatment Transition Decision (Day 40)
data.description: Decision at completion of both inpatient periods regarding transition back to prior therapy, other standard of care, or preapproval access continuation of ALXN1840.
